parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The number of instances to create. Valid range: **1** to **100**.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically renew the subscription when it expires. Valid values:

- true

- false (Default)

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically apply a coupon to the purchase. Valid values:

- true: A coupon is automatically applied.

- false (Default): A coupon is not applied.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the edge node.

parameters.name: EnvironmentVar
parameters.description: The environment variables for the instance, specified in JSON format.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: The refresh rate in hertz (Hz). Valid values: 30 and 60.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type for the AIC. Valid values:

- aic.cf52r.c1.np

- aic.cf52r.c2.np

- aic.cf53r.c2.np

- aic.cf52r.c4.np

- aic.cf53r.c3.np

- aic.cf52r.c3.np

- aic.cf53r.c1.np

- aic.cf53r.c5.np

- aic.cf53r.c6

- aic.cf53r.c4.np

- aic.cf53r.c6.np

- aic.cf53r.c7.np

- aic.cf52m1r.c5.np

- aic.cf53r.c8.np

- aic.cf53r.c7

- aic.cf52m1r.c2.np

- aic.cf52m1r.c1.np

- aic.cf52m1r.c3.np

- aic.cf52m1r.c4.np

- aic.cf52m1r.c6

- ens.a6c2

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the key pair.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The payment type. The only valid value is **PrePaid**.

> This service supports only the subscription (pre-paid) payment type.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. The valid values for this parameter depend on the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

- If `PeriodUnit` is `Month`, valid values are 1–9 and 12.

- If `PeriodUnit` is `Day`, the value must be 3.

- If PeriodUnit is Month, Period can be a value from 1 to 9, or 12.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The time unit for the subscription duration. Valid values:

- `Month` (default)

- `Day`

- If PeriodUnit is Monthc, Period can be an integer from 1 to 9, or 12.

parameters.name: ServerType
parameters.description:
The server type. Valid values:

- cas.cf53r

- cas.cf52r

- cas.cf52m1r

- cas.tg52g2

- ens.afq-c2m3i.medium

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the instance. Each tag is a key-value pair.
